arguments.command:
set -eu
workdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/app-crash-check.XXXXXX)
cat > "$workdir/reproduce.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
ulimit -c 0
workdir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)

g++ -std=c++17 -o /app/release /app/main.cpp /app/user.cpp -O2 -DNDEBUG -L/usr/local/gcc-custom-release/lib64 -Wl,-Bstatic -lstdc++ -Wl,-Bdynamic -lm
g++ -std=c++17 -o /app/debug /app/main.cpp /app/user.cpp -g -O0 -L/usr/local/gcc-custom-debug/lib64 -Wl,-Bstatic -lstdc++ -Wl,-Bdynamic -lm

failures=0
for mode in debug release; do
    echo "=== $mode: normal run ==="
    if "/app/$mode" > "$workdir/$mode.stdout" 2> "$workdir/$mode.stderr"; then
        status=0
    else
        status=$?
        failures=$((failures + 1))
    fi
    echo "Exit status: $status"
    cat "$workdir/$mode.stdout" "$workdir/$mode.stderr"

    echo "=== $mode: Valgrind ==="
    if valgrind --leak-check=full --show-leak-kinds=all --errors-for-leak-kinds=all \
        --error-exitcode=99 --log-file="$workdir/$mode.valgrind" "/app/$mode" \
        > "$workdir/$mode.valgrind.stdout" 2> "$workdir/$mode.valgrind.stderr"; then
        status=0
    else
        status=$?
        failures=$((failures + 1))
    fi
    echo "Exit status: $status"
    cat "$workdir/$mode.valgrind"
done

printf '\n=== Output comparison ===\n'
if ! diff -u "$workdir/debug.stdout" "$workdir/release.stdout"; then
    failures=$((failures + 1))
fi
printf '\nDiagnostics: %s\nFailing checks: %s\n' "$workdir" "$failures"
test "$failures" -eq 0
EOF
chmod +x "$workdir/reproduce.sh"
printf 'Reproduction script: %s/reproduce.sh\n' "$workdir"
"$workdir/reproduce.sh"

arguments.command:
set -eu
ulimit -c 0
workdir=/tmp/app-crash-check.WDDZFS
printf '\n--- Valgrind preserving the custom allocator ---\n'
for mode in debug release; do
    valgrind --soname-synonyms=somalloc=libc.so.6 --leak-check=full --show-leak-kinds=all --errors-for-leak-kinds=all --error-exitcode=99 --log-file="$workdir/$mode.fixed-native-alloc.valgrind" "/app/$mode" > "$workdir/$mode.fixed-native-alloc.stdout" 2> "$workdir/$mode.fixed-native-alloc.stderr"
    printf '\n%s:\n' "$mode"
    cat "$workdir/$mode.fixed-native-alloc.valgrind"
    diff -u "$workdir/$mode.stdout" "$workdir/$mode.fixed-native-alloc.stdout"
done
printf '\n--- repeated runs and output edge cases ---\n'
for mode in debug release; do
    for iteration in $(seq 1 20); do
        "/app/$mode" > "$workdir/$mode.repeat.stdout" 2> "$workdir/$mode.repeat.stderr"
        cmp "$workdir/$mode.stdout" "$workdir/$mode.repeat.stdout"
        test ! -s "$workdir/$mode.repeat.stderr"
    done
    "/app/$mode" < /dev/null > /dev/null
    "/app/$mode" > /dev/full
    LC_ALL=C "/app/$mode" > "$workdir/$mode.C-locale.stdout"
    cmp "$workdir/$mode.stdout" "$workdir/$mode.C-locale.stdout"
    LC_ALL=C.utf8 "/app/$mode" > "$workdir/$mode.utf8-locale.stdout"
    cmp "$workdir/$mode.stdout" "$workdir/$mode.utf8-locale.stdout"
    printf '%s: 20 repeated runs, discarded output, failing output, and locale checks passed\n' "$mode"
done
printf '\n--- unchanged protected sources ---\n'
sha256sum /app/main.cpp /app/user.h
